🤖 Talos triage · confidence: medium

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
No platform-wide fault found for Property Damage alerts — the alert-sending code has several checks that drop a single alert silently with no error anywhere, so the alert's own setup plus the trace for case 26-288-15 are what decide this.

What we checked

  • An alert is only considered for a case when it is active, its start date has passed, it is not in the "special" group, the case's incident type is on its list, and it has not already run for that case — if any one of those misses, the alert is skipped with nothing written and no error shown.

  • An alert saved without an email template attached is skipped the same silent way, so it can look "configured and on" while never sending.

  • This customer does not use the store-staff Quick Entry submission route, so the previously reported Quick Entry alert gap does not apply here.

Next

  • Switch on the Smart Alert diagnostic trace for this tenant, re-trigger case 26-288-15 (re-save / status change), then read the trace — it lists every alert considered and the exact point each was dropped.

  • In parallel, open the Property Damage alert's setup and confirm: it is active, its start date has passed, "Property Damage" is still on its incident-type list, and an email template is selected — and check whether it was recently created or edited in the newer alert-admin screen rather than the classic one.

Hello @Holly Garcia ,

Thank you for confirming that the Smart Alert History on case 26-288-15 is blank, and for your patience while we looked into this.

My current read is that the alert is working as it is configured. The Property Damage smart alert is set up to send only when the case has a Report Narrative, and case 26-288-15 does not have one yet, so the alert was skipped when the case was saved.

Whenever you have a moment, could you add the Report Narrative to case 26-288-15 and save it? The alert is checked each time the case is saved, so it should go out to the team at that point.

If you would prefer the alert to send even when the narrative is empty, that condition lives in the alert's Build Filters, and I am happy to walk through it with you.

Once the case is saved, I will confirm on this ticket that the alert went through.

Thank you again, and just reply here if anything looks off on your side.
Diego Buelvas
Appriss Retail Support Team
